note: Provenance: the first full-census completion of 2026-08-16 (journaled receipt seq 2071: 911 fixtures, 504 complete, 111 incomplete, 296 unsupported, 0 invalid) established this ratchet. A later full run the same day, in this lane, measured 584 complete / 143 incomplete / 184 unsupported / 0 invalid over 45m34s of analysis wall across 32 workers, so the mark is recorded at that higher measured floor: complete rose by 80 and unsupported fell by 112. Incomplete rose from 111 to 143 in that run, because the distribution moved out of unsupported into complete and incomplete together; the incomplete ceiling is therefore recorded where it was measured rather than where it was hoped. The sample lane is the stride-6 projection of the same walk. The full lane is authoritative only on a full-corpus run; the next full bounded run revalidates both numbers.
